changes.why: The report's own analysis contrasts missed-opportunity distributions across several race and region groups, set side by side with no computed contrast; the 2022 vs 2021 percent increase is framing for the case count.

equity.level_reason: Missed-opportunity distributions are reported and described by race and ethnicity of the birth parent, but only set side by side and framed as gaps present in all groups; the race disparity and systemic racism are cited from earlier reports, not quantified here.

level_alternative.reason: The Introduction and Discussion frame racial disparities and name systemic racism; a reader treating the group-specific shares as a quantified contrast could reach 3.
